head_commit.message:
Prefill rename prompt with current thread name

Addresses #12178

Problem: The TUI /rename prompt opened blank even when the current thread already had a custom name, making small edits awkward.

Solution: Let custom prompts receive initial text and prefill /rename with the existing thread name while preserving the empty prompt for unnamed threads.
